description: This file defines the custom exception class `FeaturePropertiesNotModifiableException` used in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically indicating that feature properties on a Thing cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. It includes constructor methods, a builder class, and metadata such as error codes and message templates.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating feature properties cannot be modified due to permission issues, with builder support and JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: FeaturePropertiesNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of `FeaturePropertiesNotModifiableException`.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a `FeaturePropertiesNotModifiableException`, given a ThingId and feature ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a provided message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers, decoding the message from the JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with the specified Ditto headers.
